name: firestarter
description: AI-native commerce execution: search products, buy with approval, track orders, manage listings, connect Shopify, and monitor prices.
long_description: Firestarter gives Claude the ability to find, buy, ship, and track real products, and to run a seller business end to end. After installing, paste your Firestarter API key (fs_live_... or fs_test_...) and Claude can execute purchases with your approval, watch prices, manage listings, and view payouts. The key is stored securely in your OS keychain. All requests go to https://api.firestarter.network.

api_key.title: Firestarter API Key
api_key.description: Your fs_live_... (live) or fs_test_... (sandbox) key from firestarter.network/dashboard

api_url.title: API Base URL (advanced)
api_url.description: Override the Firestarter API base URL. Leave as default unless instructed.

tools.name: firestarter_execute
tools.description: Submit a natural-language purchase request; searches, prices, and presents options for approval.

tools.name: firestarter_status
tools.description: Check the status of an execution or list recent ones.

tools.name: firestarter_approve
tools.description: Approve an execution and pay for the selected option.

tools.name: firestarter_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an execution and trigger a refund if already paid.

tools.name: firestarter_message
tools.description: Send a follow-up to refine an in-progress execution.

tools.name: firestarter_track_order
tools.description: Track delivery for a shipped order.

tools.name: firestarter_return
tools.description: Initiate a return for a completed order.

tools.name: firestarter_watch
tools.description: Create a price or stock monitor.

tools.name: firestarter_seller_orders
tools.description: View incoming orders as a seller.
